Ramdular vs State Of U.P. on 18 August, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:166239
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 34458 of 2023

Applicant :- Ramdular
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Manoj Kumar Mishra,Prabhu Narain Tiwari

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Heard Sri Manoj Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr.S.B.Maurya, learned AGA-I, for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.79 of 2023, under Sections 498A and 304-B IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Lalganj, District Mirzapur during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his other family members including the husband of the deceased, i.e., his son and according to the FIR, marriage of the son of applicant was performed with the daughter of the informant about 5 years before and after marriage applicant and his family members tortured her for Rs. Two Lacs and a motorcycle and on 3.4.2023 informant received an information that her daughter has committed suicide.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is the father-in-law of the deceased and entire allegation of torture and demand of dowry made against the applicant is totally false and Ramdular vs State Of U.P. on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126973171/
1 baseless.
5. He further submits that actually applicant was residing separately along with his elder son, Ram Asrey, and he was not having any concern with the family affairs of the deceased and her husband.
6. He further submits, it appears that some dispute arose between husband and wife and due to that reason deceased committed suicide.

7. He further submits that as per the autopsy report of the deceased it appears that she died due to hanging .
8.
He further submits that applicant is not having any previous criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 3.4.2023.

9.. Per contra learned AGA although opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that applicant is the father-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against him and the autopsy report of the deceased shows that she died due to hanging.
10. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. Although daughter-in-law of the applicant died within 7 years of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry and torture but applicant is the father-in-law of the deceased and no specific allegation has been made against him rather from the FIR it reflects that there is specific allegation of assault and torture against the son of applicant, i..e, husband of the deceased.
12. Further, from the perusal of the autopsy report of the deceased it appears that she died due to hanging and applicant is in jail in the present matter since April, 2023.

13. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
14. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

15. Let the applicant-Ramdular be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from Ramdular vs State Of U.P. on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126973171/
2 disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
16. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

17. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 18.8.2023 SKM  Ramdular vs State Of U.P. on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126973171/
